The NetBSD Project

NetBSD is a free, fast, secure, and highly portable Unix-like Open Source operating system. It is available for a wide range of platforms, from large-scale servers and powerful desktop systems to handheld and embedded devices.

» Learn more

11.1 available!

The NetBSD project is pleased to announce » NetBSD 11.1 «, the first update to the nineteenth major release of NetBSD.

Get NetBSD

NetBSD 11.1, released on November 2, 2026. » Release Notes «

CPU Machines Install media
amd64 64-bit x86-family machines with AMD or Intel CPUs USB image, DVD, CD
arm ARM systems like Raspberry Pi, PINE64, ODROID, "ServerReady" machines more Various boards, original RPi
i386 32-bit x86-family generic machines USB image, DVD, CD
mips MIPS systems like EdgeRouter, Loongson, Malta octeon, mips64el, mipsel
powerpc PowerPC systems like Nintendo Wii, DHT Walnut, RouterBOARD wii, others
sparc64 Sun UltraSPARC DVD, CD
others Amiga, Alpha, Apple PowerPC/68K, Dreamcast, SPARC32, VAX, more architectures various

A signed list of hashes for the NetBSD 11.1 distribution.
The NetBSD Security Officer's PGP key used to sign the list of hashes.

Donate

Donations to The NetBSD Foundation allow the project to purchase build hardware and fund development.
Some recently funded projects are:

  • arm64 package build server
  • Wi-Fi renewal
  • LLDB and upstream LLVM support
  • ptrace and GDB improvements
Please consider donating if you would like to see more of this work:
  • Donate using Stripe
  • Donate or Subscribe with PayPal
  • Sponsor NetBSD on GitHub

NetBSD is a free, fast, secure, and highly portable Unix-like Open Source operating system. It is available for a wide range of platforms, from large-scale servers and powerful desktop systems to handheld and embedded devices.

» Learn more

## 11.1 available!

The NetBSD project is pleased to announce » NetBSD 11.1 «, the first update to the nineteenth major release of NetBSD.

## Get NetBSD

NetBSD 11.1, released on November 2, 2026. » Release Notes «

```
CPU | Machines | Install media
amd64 | 64-bit x86-family machines with AMD or Intel CPUs | USB image, DVD, CD
arm | ARM systems like Raspberry Pi, PINE64, ODROID, "ServerReady" machines more | Various boards, original RPi
i386 | 32-bit x86-family generic machines | USB image, DVD, CD
mips | MIPS systems like EdgeRouter, Loongson, Malta | octeon, mips64el, mipsel
powerpc | PowerPC systems like Nintendo Wii, DHT Walnut, RouterBOARD | wii, others
sparc64 | Sun UltraSPARC | DVD, CD
others | Amiga, Alpha, Apple PowerPC/68K, Dreamcast, SPARC32, VAX, more architectures | various
```

A signed list of hashes for the NetBSD 11.1 distribution. The NetBSD Security Officer's PGP key used to sign the list of hashes.

## Donate

Donations to The NetBSD Foundation allow the project to purchase build hardware and fund development. Some recently funded projects are:

- arm64 package build server
- Wi-Fi renewal
- LLDB and upstream LLVM support
- ptrace and GDB improvements
